checks_run.procedure: Live shell scenario on a disposable PostgreSQL 16 cluster with SYNTHETIC seed data. Steps: migrate a fresh database twice, seed-dev, start the API and the worker, then run the API probe (modes, tz/currency defaults, the 422 G6 close rule, If-Match/428/409, scoped access/404, admin has no business data, CSRF, cursor pagination, provisional branding tokens, preferences, BU cycle guard, destination-scope rule, audit events). Also: DB-level cycle trigger, outbox, worker SIGTERM, rate-limit keying, and AR/EN screens.
checks_run.environment: Disposable clone; Node v22.22.2; PostgreSQL 16.13 (disposable initdb on 127.0.0.1:54393); headless Chromium from /opt/pw-browsers
checks_run.expected: all probe assertions PASS; refused closures return 422 and the record is unchanged; no DG7 or real approval claimed; no foreign requests
checks_run.actual: Probe SUMMARY pass=49 fail=0, rate-limit SUMMARY pass=7 fail=0. draft/active/on_hold -> closed all return 422 invalid_transition ('Closure requires the G6 (Sustain) business approval with validated benefits, which is not available in this release'). The record is unchanged, no audit event is written for a refused close, and close+rename is refused atomically. TL out-of-scope reads/creates return 404; the admin sees no business records. Defaults are Asia/Riyadh/SAR; the modular entry phase is configurable. 7 branding tokens with provenance=provisional. A DB trigger blocks the owner-role cycle UPDATE (psql exit 1). Outbox 7/7 published; the worker exits 0 on SIGTERM and the API stays ready. index.html has lang=ar dir=rtl. foreignRequests=[] for every screen.

summary: Round-4 re-gate of candidate 6e0c0db1. The only change since round 3 is test tooling (apps/web/tsconfig.e2e.json and the typecheck script, F-DG1-147); a fail-then-pass probe confirms the new typecheck covers the e2e specs. No regression in the domain: the 422/G6 close rule, scoped access, provisional brand, no official PMI/Mobily claim, AR-RTL/EN-LTR, no CDN, Unknown/Stale and decimal invariants are untouched (no domain source changed), and the live scenario passes 49/49 + 7/7.
